strip.title: How many hours is your team losing?
strip.description: Four short questions, your own figures. You see the estimate straight away — no email needed.

modal.title: How many hours is your team losing?
modal.description: Four short questions. Your figures, your estimate — nothing is sent anywhere unless you ask for the report.

people.label: How many people do repetitive admin work?
people.help: Everyone who spends part of a normal week on manual, repeating tasks.

hours.label: How many hours a week does each of them spend on it?
hours.help: An average is fine. Think of an ordinary week, not your busiest one.

cost.label: What does an hour of their time cost you?
cost.help: Gross cost to the company per hour, not take-home pay. Change it if 40 is not right for your team.

tasksStep.label: Which tasks does that work involve?
tasksStep.help: Pick everything that applies. This shapes the breakdown report; it does not change the numbers.
tasksStep.optional: Optional — you can skip this step.

result.title: Here is what that time is worth
result.rangeHelp: That is {{low}}% to {{high}}% of the hours above.
result.estimateNote: This is an estimate based on the figures you entered and the assumptions below. It is not a measurement of your business, and we would confirm it with you before anyone builds anything.
result.assumption1: Your figures: {{people}} people × {{hours}} hours a week × {{cost}} an hour.
result.assumption2: {{weeks}} working weeks a year, allowing for holidays and public holidays.
result.assumption3: The {{low}}%–{{high}}% band is the planning range we scope automation projects with. Where a business lands inside it depends on its tools, its data and how consistent the process already is.
result.assumption4: The figures are gross: they do not subtract the cost of building and running the automation.

email.title: Want the breakdown?
email.description: We will email you a short report, written around the tasks you picked:
email.bullet1: Your tasks ranked by the time we would expect to save first
email.bullet2: What we would automate first, and why
email.bullet3: What is probably not worth automating
email.label: Work email
email.consent: Impera may email me this report and follow up about it. See the <link>Privacy Policy</link>.
email.successNote: The report should reach your inbox within a few minutes. Check your spam folder if it does not.
email.invalidEmail: Please enter a valid email address
email.consentRequired: Please tick the box so we may send you the report.
email.error: We could not send that. Please try again.
